question: An object of height 3 cm is placed at a distance 1.5f in front of a convex lens of focal length f. The magnification will be:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.0**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lens Formula:**
 
• The lens formula relates the object distance (u), image distance (v), and focal length (f) of a lens:
 
• 1/v - 1/u = 1/f
 
• **Given Values:**
 
 
• Object height (h₀) = 3 cm
 
• Object distance (u) = -1.5f (negative because the object is in front of the lens)
 
• Focal length (f) = f
